answers.core:
It goes with Godot philosophy. Many other fields throughout the engine accept custom resources, so it makes sense that this one would, too.

I think an add-on here would be clunky. TileSets are already a core feature, and this makes that core feature better with no (from what I can see) downsides.
answers.workaround: It's used pretty often in my game, as it's a core feature. The workaround—to use scenes themselves as tiles—would mean creating loads of scenes that are just slight variants from each other. Lots more inheritance that's not really needed.

title: Allow specifying custom Resources in custom tilemap data
